goals.acceptance: Meta-spec lifecycle is explicit and blocks direct proposal-to-promotion.
Frozen release contracts and no-goalpost-movement invariant are defined.
Permanent regression registry and promotion regression gate are defined.
Independent evaluator role and no-self-certification invariant are defined.

promotion_rule: Promote only if all critical gates/regressions pass, frozen goals are satisfied, evaluation is independently reproducible, and no critical open defect exists.
notes: This contract is a design-time frozen baseline for the v0.01→v0.02 recursive experiment.
